Mode.Province.Name: Province Edit
Mode.Province.Action.select_tool_click: Select hex (rectangle mode: set the start; polygon mode: add a vertex)
Mode.Province.Action.select_tool_finish: Finish rectangle / cancel polygon / paint with the brush
Mode.Province.Note.region: Several hexes selected: C copies the region, V pastes it once at the selection's top-left hex; capitals inside move with it
Mode.Province.Action.close_polygon: Close the polygon (or left-click its first vertex)
Mode.Province.Action.apply: Create a province from the selected hexes (capital = land hex nearest the centre)
Mode.Province.Note.brush: Brush: copy a province value with C first, then hold the right button and drag to paint
Mode.Province.Action.generate_isolated_c: Grow provinces around all isolated capitals
Mode.Province.Action.expand_all_province: Expand all provinces to fill the map
Mode.Province.Action.process_isolated_em: Fix isolated and empty province hexes
Mode.Province.Action.flood_fill: Flood fill (copy a province value first)
Mode.Province.Action.generate_provinces_: Generate provinces (along the hand-drawn borders if any, otherwise from the background image)
Mode.Province.Action.toggle_boundary_dra: Toggle border drawing (right-drag to draw border lines freehand)
Mode.Province.Note.pen_width: In border-drawing mode [ / ] change the border pen width
Mode.Province.Note.boundary1: Hand-drawn borders are shown in red. Useful when the image borders are not recognised well: trace the province borders yourself,
Mode.Province.Note.boundary2: then press P to split provinces along your lines (each area goes to its nearest capital).
Mode.Province.Msg.RectAnchor: Rectangle start ({0},{1}): right-click the end hex to select

Mode.Province.Msg.ConfirmClearAll:
Clear all provinces (set every hex to 0xFFFF)?
